# shelter-kit

> Building a Blossom (BUD-01 etc.) blob store means writing content
> addressing, retention, mirror repair and BUD authorisation again for every
> product. shelter-kit is a transport-neutral Rust core for a secure,
> content-addressed Blossom store, factored out so storage policy is not
> coupled to one network listener or UI.

It is a library, not a daemon: a product supplies the listener, transport and
user experience (Tor, direct HTTPS, or another adapter), and shelter-kit
supplies the unbound Axum router, BUD authorisation, streaming
content-addressed store, retention policy, and verified mirror/repair path.
Wildbloom Node and Bothy are separate products built on the same core because
publishing and private shelter have different consent and failure modes.

## Getting Started

```toml
[dependencies]
shelter-kit = { git = "https://github.com/forgesworn/shelter-kit", tag = "v0.4.1" }
```

```rust
use shelter_kit::{AppState, BlossomConfig, Store, StoreConfig, router};

let store = Store::open(store_config)?;
let state = AppState::new(store, blossom_config)?;
let app = router(state);
```

Mount `app` into the product's own listener.

## Key Concepts

- `Store` - content-addressed storage: streaming reserve, hash verification,
  retention tiers, eviction, integrity scanning and repair.
- `AppState` - the BUD router's state: owner keys, friend grants and quota,
  each re-suppliable at runtime and swapped at a reconcile boundary.
- `AuthPolicy` - verifies BUD-01 upload, delete and list events against
  accepted servers and, optionally, an allowed pubkey set.
- `BlobFetcher` - the transport boundary for mirroring and repair, kept
  separate from authorisation and storage; `DirectHttpsFetcher` and
  `TorHttpFetcher` are the supplied adapters.
- `AdmissionFilter` - an optional, deterministic, I/O-free check on the
  first bytes of an upload, mirror or repair (`SealedParcelsOnly` is
  supplied).

## API Surface

- `router(state: AppState) -> Router` - the BUD route set.
- `Store::open`, `Store::open_with_admission_filter`, `Store::begin_upload`,
  `Store::begin_claimed_upload`, `Store::begin_claimed_mirror`,
  `Store::write_tombstone`, `Store::verify_integrity`,
  `Store::repair_candidates`, `Store::begin_repair`.
- `AppState::new`, `AppState::with_fetcher`, `AppState::set_owner_keys`,
  `AppState::set_friend_grants`, `AppState::set_quota`,
  `AppState::reconcile_now`, `AppState::write_tombstone`.
- `AuthPolicy::new`, `with_allowed_pubkeys`, `with_public_writes`,
  `verify_upload`, `verify_delete`, `verify_list`.
